frame.alignment: Fixed DE440 PA to DE421 ME offset; NAIF sampled mismatch is up to ~0.53 m (2000–2040).
frame.conventions: Planetocentric north latitude, east longitude [0,360), radial up, azimuth N=0° clockwise through east, metres for terrain, SPICE vectors in km, UTC epoch seconds.

ephemeris.note: Raw kernel intervals. Reception calculations also require target coverage at retarded epochs.

limits: One fixed study point and fixed mission inputs. Both target directions and skylines are recomputed.
Three illustrative above-ground heights. No probability distribution or hardware tolerance is implied.
The numerical refinement test does not bound DEM reconstruction error or terrain below the pixel scale.
Position errors, terrain realizations, power, communications link margins and trajectories are outside scope.

visibilityDefinitions.earth: Apparent Earth center clears the terrain skyline. Surface-terrain line of sight only.
visibilityDefinitions.joint: Both Sun-center qualification and Earth-center line of sight.
visibilityDefinitions.sun: Apparent Sun center clears the terrain skyline and is outside the apparent Earth disc. Center qualification excludes solar-disc fraction, full shadow and solar-array power.
visibilityDefinitions.uncertain: Numerical or terrain bounds overlap the qualification threshold.
visibilityDefinitions.unknown: Unresolved terrain coverage or timestamps beyond the offline bundle.

earth.scope: Whole month as a diagnostic. For mission clips, both numerical evaluations must support the decision.
